content.title: Why VCU - Virginia Commonwealth University
content.text: Home Why VCU? VCU isn’t just a university It’s a movement VCU offers GUARANTEED UNIVERSITY ADMISSION to first-year applicants who have a GPA of 3.5 or above. That means an admissions process without the stress and uncertainty that comes with the typical college selection process. Learn how it works It adds up From FY2020 to FY2024, VCU provided the most student scholarships and grants among 4-year public universities in Virginia. Innovative thinkers wanted An uncommon academic experience One of 80 public R1 universities with the Carnegie Classification’s community engagement designation A top 50 public research institution Ranked in top 20% of universities worldwide This is where it gets REAL We know that hands-on learning leads to job offers and opportunities — in a survey of May 2024 graduates, 28% of them told us it happened to them. That’s why we now require an experiential learning opportunity for every undergraduate. READ MORE A Place for Everyone Unwavering sense of community Take a tour See our unconventional campus In the Heart of Richmond An Unbeatable location From campus,it’s a 5-minute bike ride to the river 2-hour drive to D.C. There’s so much to do in Richmond and beyond… 2-hour drive to the Mountains 2-hour drive to the beach Getting there IS EASY. Support at Every Turn Unrivaled advocacy Whether you need help mapping out your path, feedback on your latest paper, guidance on paying for college, or learning accommodations, we’re here to help every step of the way. It’s why our graduates go on to be game changers. We’ve got your back Programs to help you navigate college life Featured resources and additional support services at VCU. TimelyCare Students have free, 24/7 access to mental health crisis support on this well-being platform as well as 12 telehealth counseling sessions per year — and more.READ MORE Personalized academic advising Every undergrad works with an advisor who helps them navigate college and graduate on time, on their schedule. READ MORE YouFirst at VCU Provides mentorship, resources and events to first-generation college students and connects them with other first-gen students and faculty. READ MORE Career Services Offers job and internship listings, career advising appointments, free headshots and even free gently used professional clothing and styling services.
